verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never shows Pipecat or Pipecat Cloud letting users subscribe to platform events via outbound webhooks. The only webhook mentions concern telephony carriers (Twilio, Telnyx, etc.) calling the developer's own endpoint to start a call. That is inbound carrier integration, not a Pipecat event-subscription feature. Turn events and client SDK events are in-process or client-side event handlers, not webhook subscriptions.
